q: 你家有洗衣机___？
en: Do you have a washing machine at home?

q: 你想喝什么___？
en: What do you want to drink?

q: 你爸爸喜欢这个杯子___？
en: Does your dad like this cup?

q: 你要现金还是刷卡___？
en: Will you pay cash or by card?

q: 你们明天去不去超市___？
en: Are you going to the supermarket tomorrow or not?

q: 我不知道是谁的，这个钱包是你的___？
en: I don't know whose it is. Is this wallet yours?

q: 你是想知道哪家超市的东西最便宜___？
en: Do you want to know which supermarket has the cheapest things?

q: 你们家每个月的水电费都是妈妈一个人付___？
en: Is it always Mom alone who pays the utility bills every month?

q: 我吃面条，你___？
en: I'm having noodles. What about you?

q: 我的钥匙___？
en: Where are my keys?

q: 妈妈去超市了，爸爸___？
en: Mom went to the supermarket. What about Dad?

q: 这个太贵了，那个___？
en: This one is too expensive. What about that one?

q: 你到底想不想买这台电视___？
en: So do you want to buy this TV or not?

q: 我们怎么把这个大沙发搬回家___？
en: So how are we going to get this big sofa home?

q: 你昨天说奶奶要来，她什么时候到___？
en: You said yesterday that Grandma is coming. When does she arrive?

q: 家里的钱已经不够了，下个月的房租怎么办___？
en: The money at home is already not enough. What are we going to do about next month's rent?

q: 别吵，弟弟在写作业___。
en: Don't make noise; my younger brother is doing homework.

q: 爸爸还没回家___。
en: Dad hasn't come home yet.

q: 现在才六点___，再睡一会儿。
en: It's only six o'clock now; sleep a little longer.

q: 妈妈正在做饭___，你先别进去。
en: Mom is cooking right now; don't go in yet.

q: 这件外套我还没付钱___，不能带走。
en: I haven't paid for this coat yet, so I can't take it.

q: 门口站着好几个人___，你去看看是谁。
en: Several people are standing at the door; go and see who it is.

q: 你以为我会买吗？我才不买___！
en: You think I'd buy it? I certainly won't buy it!

q: 别急着收拾，爷爷奶奶还没到___，客人都要六点以后才来。
en: Don't rush to tidy up. Grandpa and Grandma haven't arrived yet, and the guests won't come until after six.

q: 这个月的工资还没发___，我哪有钱买新手机？
en: This month's pay hasn't come in yet; where would I get money for a new phone?

q: 我们回家___。
en: Let's go home.

q: 天太热了，你们喝点水___。
en: It's too hot; why don't you drink some water.

q: 这个杯子很便宜，你买___。
en: This cup is cheap; why don't you buy it?

q: 太晚了，我们明天再去超市___。
en: It's too late; let's go to the supermarket tomorrow.

q: 好___，这个价钱我就买了。
en: All right then, at this price I'll buy it.

q: 你先把菜洗好，我来切___。
en: You wash the vegetables first, and I'll chop them.

q: 要是价钱谈不下来，你就别买了，我们去别的店看看___。
en: If you can't get the price down, don't buy it; let's look in other shops.

q: 你妈妈累了一天了，今晚的碗就让我们来洗___。
en: Your mom has been tired all day; let's wash tonight's dishes ourselves.

q: 我看你们很像，你是小王的妈妈___？
en: You look alike, so you're Xiao Wang's mom, right?

q: 你常常去那家超市，你家离那儿很近___？
en: You often go to that supermarket, so your home is close to it, I suppose?

q: 这条裙子看起来很好，不便宜___？
en: This skirt looks nice; it isn't cheap, I suppose?

q: 你们家今年大概不回老家过年了___？
en: You probably won't go back to your hometown for New Year this year, I suppose?

q: 爸爸应该已经买好票了___？
en: Dad should have bought the tickets already, I take it?

q: 你一个月的工资一定不少___？
en: You surely earn a good salary a month, I suppose?

q: 看你买了这么多东西，今天的特价活动你一定早就知道了___？
en: Seeing how much you bought, you must have known about today's sale long ago, I take it?

q: 你刚搬来这个小区，邻居们还不太熟___？
en: You just moved into this neighborhood, so you probably don't know the neighbors well yet?

q: 这个蛋糕真好吃___！
en: This cake is so delicious!

q: 妈妈做的饭多香___！
en: How tasty Mom's cooking is!

q: 快来___，饭做好了！
en: Come on, hurry, the meal is ready!

q: 这家店的衣服真便宜！是___，我们多买几件。
en: The clothes in this shop are so cheap! Yes, they are; let's buy a few more.

q: 奶奶，您慢点走___，小心台阶！
en: Grandma, walk slowly, mind the steps!

q: 这个孩子长得多可爱___！
en: How cute this child is!

q: 你们看，这个小区的环境多好___，楼下还有一个大超市！
en: Look how nice this neighborhood is, and there's a big supermarket downstairs!

q: 能和家人一起过年，真是太幸福___！
en: Being able to spend New Year with the family is so happy!

q: 你是我哥哥___，当然要帮我。
en: You're my older brother, after all; of course you should help me.

q: 太贵了，不买就不买___。
en: It's too expensive. If we don't buy it, we don't buy it.

q: 我早就说过___，这家店最便宜。
en: I told you long ago, didn't I: this shop is the cheapest.

q: 你想吃就吃___，家里又不缺吃的。
en: If you want to eat it, just eat it; it's not as if we're short of food at home.

q: 孩子还小___，你别要求他自己洗衣服。
en: The child is still little, after all; don't demand that he wash his own clothes.

q: 这个价钱本来就不高___，不用再砍价了。
en: This price wasn't high to begin with, so there's no need to bargain any more.

q: 不喜欢这个颜色就换一个___，店里还有很多别的颜色。
en: If you don't like this color, just swap it for another; the shop has plenty of other colors.

q: 他自己愿意花钱买，你就让他买___，反正是他自己的零花钱。
en: If he's willing to spend his own money, just let him buy it; it's his own pocket money anyway.

q: 别哭了，爸爸一定会来___。
en: Don't cry; Dad will definitely come.

q: 我保证，这个杯子不会坏___。
en: I promise, this cup won't break.

q: 别担心钱的事，我们家的日子会越来越好___。
en: Don't worry about money; our family's life will get better and better.

q: 你放心，我不会告诉妈妈这件事___。
en: Don't worry, I won't tell Mom about this.

q: 虽然现在东西很贵，但是你相信我，过几个月价钱一定会降___。
en: Things are expensive now, but trust me, prices will definitely drop in a few months.

q: 你不用担心奶奶，她的病只要好好吃药，很快就会好___。
en: No need to worry about Grandma; as long as she takes her medicine, she will soon be well.

q: 我已经不想买手机___。
en: I don't want to buy a phone any more.

q: 天黑___，我们回家吧。
en: It's dark now; let's go home.

q: 弟弟现在有手机___。
en: My younger brother has a phone now.

q: 这家店现在不打折___，你来晚了。
en: This shop isn't having sales any more; you came too late.

q: 我的钱包里没有钱___，得去银行取一点。
en: There's no money left in my wallet now; I have to withdraw some at the bank.

q: 孩子们都长大___，不再需要我们每天接送了。
en: The children have all grown up and no longer need us to take them to and from school every day.

q: 他现在是我们小区最大的超市老板___，过去只是个小店员。
en: He is now the owner of the biggest supermarket in our neighborhood; in the past he was just a small clerk.
Let's go home together.
Grandpa hasn't got up yet.

Where is my wallet?
You must have known this price long ago, I take it?
Do you want to drink tea?
task: Turn it into a yes/no question.

task: Soften it into a gentle suggestion.

task: Say he is sleeping right now.

en: I don't want to buy that old TV any more.
task: Say you don't want to buy it any more.

en: Don't worry, Grandpa will definitely get better.
task: Reassure the listener with 一定 and a final particle.
